acceptanceCriteria: GitHub API requests use an available workflow token without exposing it to artifact downloads.
Staged and public adopter acceptance workflows pass the token to the API-bound harness steps.
Unauthenticated local/public use remains supported when no token is configured.
Regression tests fail before the fix and pass after it.
Existing release, isolation, cleanup, and public-artifact checks remain unchanged and pass.
goal: Make staged and public adopter acceptance deterministic under repeated Release API access without weakening public artifact or isolation checks.
intent: Prevent release adopter acceptance from failing on GitHub API rate limiting by carrying the workflow token into repository-bound release API requests.
outOfScope: Release artifact contents and installer implementation
